description: roadmap.md — the largest file. Convert all 25 Python code fences to simple Java (delete the Python versions), do the three targeted content rewrites (LSP, DIP, Interface-vs-abstract-class), ensure each of the 8 design-pattern sections has a one-line plain-language definition + a clear simple-Java showcase, and fix the 5 Markdown list-rendering bugs. Independent of the other features (distinct file).
steps: Read LLD/roadmap.md fully first. Update the front-matter `description` and the `!!! note "Language"` admonition near the top so the page reads Java-primary instead of 'Python (primary) with Java equivalents'.

Convert every ```python fence to ```java across sections 1-6 (OOP basics; Four pillars; Relationships; SOLID; Interface vs abstract; Design patterns). DELETE each Python block. Where a Java block ALREADY follows the Python one (common here), just delete the Python block and keep the single Java block — do NOT leave two Java blocks. Keep Python-vs-Java PROSE notes (no true final, no native overloading, modules-are-singletons, MRO) but show Java code only. Keep the 2 ```mermaid blocks untouched.

LSP rewrite (## L - Liskov Substitution Principle): replace Square/Rectangle with a Bird/Penguin example. BAD: `Bird` has `fly()`; `Penguin extends Bird` must throw/no-op; show a concrete caller (e.g. `makeAllFly(List<Bird>)`) that breaks on the penguin. GOOD: restructure (`Bird` base + `FlyingBird` or a `CanFly` capability) so a non-flying bird is never forced to fly. Add 1-2 sentences on WHY the bad version breaks the caller. Simple Java.

DIP rewrite (## D - Dependency Inversion Principle): keep OrderService + Database in Java; make DI explicit via CONSTRUCTOR injection. Expand the trailing note into 2-4 beginner-friendly sentences on @Autowired: the Spring container creates the concrete bean and injects it into the constructor so the class never calls `new` on its dependency; that is DIP in practice; constructor injection is preferred over field injection.

Interface-vs-abstract rewrite (# 5. Interface vs abstract class): improve Java examples to clearly show (a) a class implementing MULTIPLE interfaces, (b) `extends` on a single abstract class, (c) ONE class doing BOTH (class Car extends Vehicle implements PaymentGateway). Keep the existing comparison table and 'Rule of thumb'. Add a short 'use interface when / use abstract class when' with a one-line real example each. Simple Java only.

Design patterns (# 6): for each of Singleton, Factory, Builder, Adapter, Decorator, Strategy, Observer, State — ensure a single plain-language 'what problem it solves' line BEFORE the code and a clear relatable simple-Java showcase. KEEP the existing Trade-offs / 'when NOT to use' notes. NOTE: State currently has prose + trade-offs but NO code block — add a short simple-Java State example (e.g. booking CREATED->HELD->PAID or a vending machine) with a one-line definition, consistent with the others.

Fix the 5 list-rendering bugs (root cause: lead-in line directly followed by list items with no blank line -> one run-on

). Insert a blank line after each lead-in; one item per line; keep wrapped continuation lines indented under their item. Locations: ~line 293 'Encapsulation vs abstraction ... :' (2 bullets); ~line 940 'Relationship arrows (memorize these ...):' (5 bullets, PRESERVE the arrow glyphs ──▷ ◆── ◇── ─── and meanings); ~line 978 '**Progression (easy -> hard):**' (numbered 1-6, item 6 wraps); ~line 987 '**How to practice each one:**' (numbered 1-7, item 6 wraps); ~line 998 '**Interview-day reminders:**' (4 bullets).

Run the strict build and the HTML list checks; fix anything the build flags. Commit locally on branch lld-java (e.g. `refactor(LLD): roadmap.md Java-primary + LSP/DIP/interface rewrites + list fixes`). Do NOT push.
acceptance_criteria: `grep -c '```python' LLD/roadmap.md` returns 0; the 2 ```mermaid blocks are intact.
`cd <worktree> && DISABLE_MKDOCS_2_WARNING=true python -m mkdocs build --strict` exits 0 with no NEW WARNING from roadmap.md.

LSP section shows the Bird/Penguin BAD+GOOD example with a breaking caller and a why-it-breaks sentence; DIP shows constructor injection + the expanded @Autowired note; section 5 shows a class implementing multiple interfaces, a class extending one abstract class, and a class doing both.
Each of the 8 pattern sections has a one-line definition + a ```java example (State now has a code example); existing trade-off/when-NOT notes preserved.

In site/LLD/roadmap/index.html the arrow glossary, Progression, How-to-practice, Interview-day, and Encapsulation-vs-abstraction blocks render as

      with
    1. items (NOT a single run-on

findings: roadmap.md converted to Java-primary. All 25 python fences removed; file now has 27 ```java + 2 ```mermaid, 0 ```python (balanced 58 fence markers). Front-matter description and the 'Language' admonition reworded to Java-primary. Where a Java block already followed a Python one (Class/object, Constructor, static, final, Encapsulation, Abstraction, Inheritance, overloading, ISP, Singleton) the Python block was deleted and the single Java block kept; the remaining Python-only blocks were rewritten to simple Java. Python-vs-Java teaching contrasts (no true final, no native overloading, multiple inheritance/MRO) retained as short prose, not code. Targeted rewrites done: LSP now Bird/Penguin with a breaking makeAllFly(List<Bird>) caller + why-it-breaks sentence + GOOD split via a CanFly capability interface; DIP uses constructor injection with a final field + expanded 4-sentence @Autowired note (container creates/injects the bean, constructor injection preferred over field injection); section 5 shows (a) ElectricCar implements Drivable+Chargeable, (b) Bike extends abstract Vehicle, (c) Car extends Vehicle implements PaymentGateway, plus 'use interface when / use abstract class when' lines. All 8 pattern sections have a one-line definition + a ```java example; State previously had NO code and now has a simple Booking Created->Held->Paid state-object example. Kept all tables, trade-off/when-NOT notes, admonitions, cross-links. Fixed all 5 list-rendering bugs (blank line inserted after each lead-in): Encapsulation-vs-abstraction (2 bullets), Relationship arrows (5 bullets, arrow glyphs preserved), Progression (ol), How-to-practice (ol), Interview-day (ul). Verified: strict build exits 0 with only pre-existing INFO (DSA anchors / relative links) and no new roadmap.md WARNING; grep -c '```python' = 0; HTML checks ARROWS_OK/PROG_OK plus the other three blocks render <ul>/<ol>/<li>. NOTE for later steps: Java is content-only (never compiled); the mkdocs language chip renders from the ```java class. Do NOT reintroduce a second Java block when a Python block was deleted. The other LLD files (LowLevelDesign.md, patterns-extended.md, concurrency.md, worked-problems.md, java-cheatsheet.md) were NOT touched by this feature.
